video_title: Bob Ryan: Celtics Should KEEP Jaylen Brown | Ryan & Goodman NBA Podcast

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: The New York Knicks' historic playoff run is unprecedented
quotes.excerpt: Never seen anything so startling. If you told me anybody was going to do what they're doing.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: Never seen anything so startling. If you told me anybody was going to do what they're doing, I would have said maybe. No, just historically, there's nothing, there's no precedent. The Lakers had some runs in the 80s, but this is astonishing.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: The New York Knicks advance to NBA Finals for the first time since 1999. Haven't lost since Game 3 vs Atlanta.

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: The New York Knicks' roster construction relied on key trades
quotes.excerpt: All the key players are people they traded for. None of these are draft picks.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: It's interesting, Gary, is that all the key players are people they traded for. None of these are draft picks. They famously traded five picks to get Miguel Bridges. But go down the list here with Karl-Anthony Towns, Minnesota; Jalen Brunson, Dallas; Josh Hart, Lakers and others; OG Anunoby, Toronto, etc. They're all draft picks.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: And Bob, if I may stop you for a moment, with the exception of probably the deal with Minnesota, all of these players have exceeded expectations.

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Tom Thibodeau's coaching style is driving the Knicks' success
quotes.excerpt: Tibs has never coached a team like that ran as much as this is running.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: Would they have done this with Tom Thibodeau still coaching?

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: Not like this. The whole, he's playing more people than Tom Thibodeau. They needed a new voice. Tom Thibodeau has never coached a team like that ran as much as this is running. No way. No way. That was a wise choice.

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Joe Mazzulla's Coach of the Year award is well-deserved
quotes.excerpt: No one on earth predicted a year for the Celtics such as they had.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: The thing as far as Joe Mazzulla is concerned, if the Celtics get bounced, the way the Celtics got bounced, we don't think Coach of the Year is like kissing your cousin.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: Well, it doesn't come at a good time, no. Of course not. We know it's about the regular season and regular season only. And no one on earth predicted a year for the Celtics such as they had. No one. No one. That's the kind of coach that gets Coach of the Year.

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: The Celtics should keep Jaylen Brown despite trade rumors
quotes.excerpt: I like the guy a lot. I just hope he can just remain composed and don't fall for the bait.

text_blocks.speaker: Gary Tanguay
text_blocks.text: What's next for Jaylen Brown and the Celtics? I like the guy a lot. I just hope he can just remain composed and don't fall for the bait. Stephen A. Smith is a very talented broadcaster. He's a personality, but don't give him, don't take the bait, Jaylen. Don't take the bait.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: Agreed. I'm not, I don't want to get too out of sorts about this whole thing. Yeah, he shouldn't have said what he said about it being my favorite year. People, it just wasn't going to be anything he could sell to the public after they just lost a 3-1 lead.

quotes.speaker: Bob Ryan
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's media violation reflects his youth
quotes.excerpt: I was stunned to learn that Victor Wembanyama stiffed the media after the game.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: I was stunned to learn that Victor Wembanyama stiffed the media after the game. They're throwing a major fine because everything about him, including this week, spectacular story about him and what he did last summer, going to China and getting involved in this mystic physical and mental treatment, amazing.

text_blocks.speaker: Bob Ryan
text_blocks.text: He's still a kid. It is a sign of immaturity. He's just not there yet. He does everything else well, and I'm not making an excuse, but that's what I'm going to, but somebody's going to talk to him.
